name: Article 9, § 1, point b – 142
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on applying a generalised scheme of tariff preferences and repealing Regulation (EU) No 978/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text: (b) it demonstrates respect for fundamental human and labour rights as reflected in the core conventions of the International Labour Organization and the main United Nations human rights instruments, without being required to ratify and effectively implement all conventions listed in Annex VI, in particular those relating primarily to climate and environmental protection or governance;
